input.summary: Add mutual aggregate liability cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, with uncapped Excluded Claims and Customer payment obligations outside the cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 excludes consequential damages but sets no aggregate cap, so each party's direct liability is unlimited. We add a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000 (the floor matters because this is a revenue-share arrangement), and keep indemnification, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other party's IP outside the cap, with Customer's payment obligations not treated as capped damages.

ops.text: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (i) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (ii) USD 1,000,000. Customer's payment obligations under this Agreement shall not be considered damages subject to this cap. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights.
